articles.summary: (NYSE: AEM) (TSX: AEM) ("Agnico Eagle" or the "Company") today reported financial and operating results for the third quarter of 2026. "Our business continues to perform well, reflecting the consistent execution of our teams across the Company. Solid operational performance contributed to strong free cash flow generation and we remain on track to achieve our full year guidance, with production expected near the lower end of the range and costs within the range despite inflationary cost pressures
articles.title: AGNICO EAGLE REPORTS THIRD QUARTER 2026 RESULTS - STRONG FREE CASH FLOW GENERATION DRIVEN BY SOLID OPERATIONAL PERFORMANCE; ON TRACK TO ACHIEVE 2026 PRODUCTION AND COST GUIDANCE
